items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Fine today with good sunny spells, although areas of high cloud may make the sunshine hazy at times. Light or moderate winds for much of the time, freshening from the northwest this evening. Maximum temperature 20°C, feeling pleasantly warm.


##Outlook##

Staying dry through the working week, with sunny spells and near average temperatures, then at some point next weekend the drought period is likely to finish as rain arrives.
